tokens.name: prompt-ink
tokens.usage: Prompt labels (CONTINUE, BACK) and the fill of every glyph: disc, keycap, mouse body. Measured #F9F9F9 in the 4K frames. Reads on every surface-* token (15.3:1 on surface-account, 10.5:1 on surface-settings, 8.5:1 on surface-settings-light, 10.0:1 on surface-calibration). It is also the title's COLOR_PROMPT_NEUTRAL: at rest the title multiplies its white icons by it (measured #F9F9F9 plate on the account prompt).

tokens.name: prompt-pressed
tokens.usage: The title's COLOR_PROMPT_PRESSED, added to an icon while its button is held: black legend and outline read #ABABAB, the plate goes to #FFFFFF and a keycap's grey lip clips to white. Measured on the account prompt with Y held (XCL, 2026-11-24). Pressed legend on the white plate is 2.2:1; it lasts only while the button is down. Kept exact.

tokens.name: glyph-legend
tokens.usage: The letter or word inside a glyph and the mouse outline/pressed zone. Measured pure black. 19.9:1 on prompt-ink.

tokens.name: hint-ink
tokens.usage: The left-aligned hint sentence in the footer ("More options available in the Settings menu."). Measured #E6E6E6; 8.9:1 on surface-settings.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Label and glyph fill of an unavailable prompt (RESTORE DEFAULT at its default value). Measured #676767 with a glyph-legend outline. Source pair misses contrast: 1.9:1 on surface-calibration. Kept exact, the black outline carries the shape.

tokens.name: surface-account
tokens.usage: Ground of the account prompt screen (ACCOUNT PICKER / SCREEN NARRATION / PLAYER1). Measured flat #20202C.

tokens.name: surface-settings
tokens.usage: First-run settings screens (Navigation Experience, Subtitles, Legal Notices): the deep end of the purple diagonal. Measured #4E3157 behind the footer.

tokens.name: surface-settings-light
tokens.usage: Light end of the purple diagonal on the settings screens. Measured #613C68 at the right edge.

tokens.name: surface-calibration
tokens.usage: Brightness calibration screen ground. Measured flat #3F3F3F.

styles.name: prompt-label
styles.usage: Action label beside a glyph, all caps. Cap height 18.5px at 1080p (37px measured at 2160p). Stand-in face: the title's own condensed face is not redistributed.

styles.name: keycap-legend
styles.usage: Word or letter inside a keycap, glyph-legend ink, all caps.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: More options available in the Settings menu.
styles.usage: Footer hint sentence, sentence case, hint-ink.

spacing.note: All lengths at 1080p. Multiply by screen height / 1080 (x2 at 2160p, where they were measured).

tokens.name: glyph-size
tokens.usage: Height of every glyph; the Xbox disc diameter (54px at 2160p). Keycaps and the mouse match it.

tokens.name: label-glyph-gap
tokens.usage: Label's right edge to its glyph (27-28px measured).

tokens.name: item-gap
tokens.usage: One prompt's glyph to the next prompt's label in a bar (41-42px measured).

tokens.name: stack-pitch
tokens.usage: Row pitch of a vertical prompt stack (104px measured).

tokens.name: safe-right
tokens.usage: Last glyph's right edge to the screen edge (80px measured).

tokens.name: safe-bottom
tokens.usage: Glyph bottom to the screen bottom (60px measured).

tokens.name: safe-left
tokens.usage: Hint text left inset (70px measured).

tokens.name: keycap-pad
tokens.usage: Inline padding inside a word keycap (ESC, ENTER).

tokens.name: radius-disc
tokens.usage: Xbox face buttons: a full disc. Never used for keys, so a key never looks like a pad button.

tokens.name: radius-keycap
tokens.usage: Keycaps: rounded square, 27x27 for letters, wider for words.

tokens.name: radius-mouse
tokens.usage: Mouse body, 20x27.
